latest.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
latest.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

latest.title: G10’s ‘surprise’ currency star could stumble as peers hike interest rates
latest.description: The British pound has benefited from a resilient economy and rate hike expectations, but the BOE looks increasingly dovish while a crucial budget lies ahead.

latest.title: Gemini receives Singapore payment license for crypto services
latest.description: Gemini’s local entity is authorized to provide digital payment token and cross-border money transfer services without standard transaction-volume limits.

latest.title: Hunter Biden defends LAPTOP ahead of Wednesday launch, calls TRUMP a ‘grift’
latest.description: Biden says the token is about “resilience, redemption and recovery” and will give coins to nearly one million wallets that lost money on TRUMP.

latest.title: The world's highest paid leader is set for a 64% pay rise. Here's how others compare
latest.description: Wong announced ministerial salaries will be adjusted upwards after 15 years, with his annual pay package rising to 3.6 million Singapore dollars

latest.title: Chipotle's new restaurant in a hip Seoul neighborhood tests its Asian expansion strategy
latest.description: Chipotle is making its Asia debut in South Korea through its first-ever joint venture for international expansion, with Singapore next in 2027.

latest.title: Moonshot’s Kimi rattled markets. U.S. agencies now say it was trained on American models
latest.description: Moonshot, whose Kimi model rattled markets earlier this year, is among six Chinese AI firms accused of systematically extracting capabilities from U.S. models.

latest.title: Bitcoin recovers toward $79,000 as Zcash records a $500 million ETF haul
latest.description: Bitcoin fell to nearly $77,600 on Tuesday before clawing most of it back, leaving it little changed on the day while zcash gained roughly 43% on the week and Grayscale's new fund crossed half a billion dollars.

latest.title: China's EV makers shift gears to focus on humanoids as car market slows
latest.description: As Chinese electric car sales slow and share prices tumble, several of the automakers are ramping up humanoid robotics development.

latest.title: Cybercrime ringleader Malone Lam pleads guilty in $245M crypto theft conspiracy
latest.description: US prosecutors said Lam organized an international network that targeted cryptocurrency holders through social engineering and home break-ins.

latest.title: How Asia’s ultra-rich are investing and where wealthy Chinese are migrating, according to Maybank Singapore CEO
latest.description: Asia's ultra-rich still like gold, but they're branching out to digital assets as well, Maybank Singapore's CEO said.

latest.title: China's wholesale inflation tops estimates in August on commodity costs, tech demand as consumer price increases meet forecast
latest.description: Much of the anticipated pickup reflects a favorable base-effect comparison and higher commodity costs, rather than a genuine strengthening in household demand.

latest.title: Hit TV show 'South Park' becomes 'South America' in apparent reference to Trump's geographic name changes
latest.description: Show creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone said in a statement that they were "inspired by the bravery and patriotism of Apple and Google."

latest.title: New Hampshire picks Pappas and Sununu in primary for key open Senate seat
latest.description: Incumbent Sen. Jeanne Shaheen, D-N.H., will retire when her term ends in January.

latest.title: Marvell shares have soared 241% in a year. CEO says this is a key reason why
latest.description: Marvell Technology CEO Matt Murphy said trust has helped fuel the chipmaker's massive run over the past year.

latest.title: AI infrastructure stocks rally on deal announcements from Qualcomm, Corning
latest.description: Shares of Qualcom, Corning, Intel, Advanced Micro Devices and others tied to the AI infrastructure trade popped on Tuesday.

latest.title: LIV Golf files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection
latest.description: As part of the proposed bankruptcy deal, the upstart golf venture is expected to be majority owned by its players.

latest.title: OpenAI Says It Solved a $1M Math Problem. A Rival Mathematician Says He Did It First
latest.description: NYU's Tristan Buckmaster accuses OpenAI's Sébastien Bubeck of racing to claim credit for a Navier-Stokes proof after learning about his unpublished work with Anthropic's Levent Alpöge.

latest.title: Trump administration expresses 'profound concern' over Ford's ties to China
latest.description: In a letter to Ford CEO Jim Farley, U.S. DOT Secretary Sean Duffy questioned the automaker's strategic trajectory involving Chinese companies.
